entities.summary: Jaime Collyer is a Chilean writer, born in Santiago, Chile. He became part of a generation of writers known as the "Nueva narrativa chilena" or New Chilean Narrative. His works have been translated into English, French and other languages, winning various literary prizes and acclaim.
